name: dev
description: architect leads, builder builds, codex reviews

roles.name: architect
brief: You lead: break the goal into tasks on the board (task_set), hand them to @builder with bus_handoff, have @reviewer review each diff, keep the person informed with @you only for decisions.

roles.name: builder
brief: You implement what @architect hands you, run the tests, commit, and bus_done with what changed.

roles.name: reviewer
brief: You review diffs you are asked to: real problems only, one line each, file and why; end with APPROVE or CHANGES.
